pages.text: Her mother took her and her brother and left her husband’s house.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: With the support of her lover, her mother started a snack bar.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: OH MAN, THAT HAIR-STYLE IS GREAT!

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: TH...THAT'S RIGHT. SORRY FOR SAYING SOMETHING WEIRD.

pages.speaker: char7
pages.text: AND YOU'RE STYLISH SO FASHIONABLE TOO!

pages.speaker: char8
pages.text: I ALSO WANT TO BE AND PEOPLE LIKE THAT.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I WAS INVITED BY HER FOR A "PART-TIME JOB" JUST NOW...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: WITH THIS, WE CAN INFILTRATE THEM AFTER ALL...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: I ALSO PERFECTLY GOT THE CONTACT ADDRESS FROM HER!

pages.speaker: char4
pages.text: WELL THEN, I'M GOING TO DANCE. A victory dance!

pages.speaker: char10
pages.text: I wonder if I will die.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: BE SURE TO DROP BY FROM TIME TO TIME.

pages.speaker: char4
pages.text: IF YOU KEEP WORRYING ABOUT OTHERS SO MUCH, YOU AREN'T GOING TO LIVE VERY LONG.

pages.speaker: char7
pages.text: I'VE ALREADY COME TO ACCEPT IT.

pages.speaker: char8
pages.text: SO JUST LET IT BE, ALREADY.

pages.speaker: char9
pages.text: THINGS LIKE THIS HAPPEN ALL THE TIME.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: DON'T GIVE ME THAT CRAP, YOU IDIOT...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: TRYING TO ACT ALL COOL AND UNBOtherED BECAUSE YOU'VE ACCEPTED THE REALITY OF THINGS...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: ALL YOU EVER SAY IS, "THAT'S HOW THINGS ARE,", OR "IT CAN'T BE HELPED."

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: STOP SPITTING OUT THAT BULLSHIT SO EASILY!!

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: EVEN THOUGH YOU'RE BOILING OVER ON THE INSIDE!!

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: BECAUSE I ABSOLUTELY HATE IT WHEN YOU SAY CRAP LIKE THAT!!

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: DIDN'T THE TEACHER EXPLAIN IT ALREADY? WE CAN'T PAY OFF OUR DEBTS, SO WE LOST THE FARM.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: BUT YOUR MOM STILL WANTS YOU TO FINISH HIGH SCHOOL, DOESN'T SHE?

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: WHY ARE YOU BEING SO STUBBORN ABOUT WORKING?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I'M... DRIPP... PING OUT TO WORK.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I HAVE TO WORK TO SAVE UP SOME MONEY... IF I DON'T, I'LL CAUSE TROUBLE FOR AKI'S FAMILY.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: THOUGH, I ALREADY HAVE TO BE COMPLETELY HONEST.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: WHEN MY OLD MAN TOOK OUT HIS LOAN TO EXPAND THE FARM,

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: HE ASKED THEM TO BE HIS CO-SIGNER.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THIS IS THE CLUB WHERE NUTCRACKER HAS BEEN APPEARING RECENTLY...

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: SENSEI, HAVE YOU EVER BEEN TO A PLACE LIKE THIS BEFORE...?

pages.speaker: char5
pages.text: I DID AN INVESTIGATION WITH AKIRA-SAN IN A PLACE LIKE THIS ONCE.

pages.speaker: char6
pages.text: I DESPERATELY STOPPED AKIRA-SAN WHEN SHE SAID "ONLY ONE DRINK"...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: DO ALL OF US... NO, DO ONLY I FEEL FUCKING OUT OF PLACE HERE...?

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: THERE AIN'T A HUGE WOMAN LIKE THIS ANYWHERE AROUND...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: PLEASE THINK OF THE TALL GIRLS.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: SNOW THIS MUCH EVERY YEAR IN THE CAPITAL?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THIS IS GOING TO END UP AFFECTING THEIR BUSINESS AS WELL.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: THAT'S WHY, EVEN IF IT'S ONLY A LITTLE, I HAVE TO HELP PAY BACK WHAT WE OWE AS FAST AS WE CAN.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: IF ANYBODY WERE TO GET HURT BECAUSE OF SOMETHING THEY DID FOR ME, I'D FEEL AWFUL ABOUT IT...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: I WANT MY LITTLE SISTERS TO BE ABLE TO GO TO COLLEGE...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: YOU'VE WORKED SO HARD TO GET THIS FAR!!

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: WHAT ABOUT ALL YOUR DREAMS? ARE YOU JUST GOING TO GIVE UP?!

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: THIS IS THE LAST OF IT.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: IT SEEMS WE’LL GET TO SEE SOME INTERESTING THINGS, DOESN'T IT...?

pages.speaker: char10
pages.text: CAME BY TO GET HIS THINGS TODAY.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I DON'T WANT YOU TO BE BURDENED BY THIS.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: ...IG IDIOT. YOU CAN'T TELL ME HOW I'M ALLOWED TO FEEL ABOUT THIS...

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I FEARED NOTHING. I HAD NOTHING TO LOSE. YET I HAD MY FIGHTING SPIRIT.

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: THE SPIRIT TO CHALLENGE THE YOSHI-OKA ...

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: I LAY RESTLESS FOR 3 DAYS AND 3 NIGHTS.

pages.speaker: char4
pages.text: IT'S BEEN A YEAR SINCE THEN.

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: YOU'RE HALF A STEP FURTHER NOW... COMPARED TO BACK THEN.

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: SHALL WE CALL OFF THIS DUEL?

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: FOR SAIKO-CHAN, WHO RECEIVED THE QS SURGERY WITHOUT HER OWN VOLITION, WHO BECAME AN INVESTIGATOR WITHOUT ANY INTENTION OF DOING SO, AND WHO CAN'T BRING OUT ANY MOTIVATION.

pages.speaker: char1
pages.text: I CAN'T HELP BUT THINK HOW IT'LL BE TO FORCE ANYMORE THAN THIS ON HER...

pages.speaker: char2
pages.text: IF SHE'S GOT MONEY PROBLEMS THEN SHE SHOULD WORK AND EARN A LIVING...

pages.speaker: char3
pages.text: BUT, SEEING THAT SHE HAS "THAT FAMILY"

pages.speaker: char4
pages.text: DON'T YOU THINK SHE SHOULD WORK MORE!?

pages.speaker: char5
pages.text: ALL SHE EVER DOES IS LAZE AROUND!

pages.speaker: char6
pages.text: THEN SHE SHOULD CUT TIES WITH HER MOM AFTER A WHILE, AIN'T THAT RIGHT?

pages.speaker: char7
pages.text: You are different from Saiko and us, aren't you?

pages.speaker: char13
pages.text: If that were me, I'd be...
